summary.text: Gary Parry is a Republican state representative from Montana who has represented House District 35 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Colstrip resident with a career as a senior contract analyst for coal companies, he chairs the House Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Gary Parry was born in Helena, Montana, lives in Colstrip, and graduated from Helena Senior High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree in geology from the University of Montana in 1975 and an M.B.A. from Sam Houston State University in 1990.
His career experience includes working as a senior contract analyst with Western Energy Company and Westmoreland Coal Company.
Parry won the House general election in 2022, representing District 39, and defeated Kim Kreider in District 35 on November 5, 2024.

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations Committee and is assigned to the House State Administration, Fish, Wildlife and Parks, and House Legislative Administration committees.
